verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's get-started docs list official SDKs for Go, Python and TypeScript, with install commands and API-key setup. The Python SDK also backs an OpenAI Agents SDK adapter, and other docs refer to SDK calls. missing for 10: in-depth SDK API reference evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install SDK — Go: go get github.com/sandbox0-ai/sdk-go; Python: pip install sandbox0; TypeScript: npm install sandbox0.
Use Sandbox0 as the backend for OpenAI Agents SDK `SandboxAgent` runs through the Sandbox0 Python SDK adapter.
